numbers.name: supply_threshold
numbers.value: with action-derived a_i, tau_i and delta: S = 1.05 S* keeps the lowest-R* mode at R = R* and n = (S - delta R*)/(a F R*) (rel 1e-3); S = 0.95 S* and S = 0 leave no mode

note: Derivation and numerical check only; no external data. The pool loss delta of the layer 3 chi stream follows from the action's quartic self-coupling (tree level, beam attenuation, Boltzmann momenta). The supply S does not follow: in a region holding only the action's fields S = 0 and every phi mode dies; a steady structure needs a boundary flux S > S* = delta R*_min, so S is set by an enclosing system. Nearest known theory: beam attenuation, chemostat dilution, laser pump threshold. Not UET-distinct.
